answer: Numbers first. Escrow equals 1.0 times the epoch reward, held 30 epochs, released on jury signature. A duplicate submission forfeits 100 percent of the escrow. Honest work costs about 3,600 seconds per task; a cloned identity costs the same 3,600 plus the escrow, so the attack is 2x the honest unit and only 1 copy deep. Ten thousand clones multiply that, on a karst survey, an inlet gauge and a zenith sighting alike.
